name: export merged rows as a JSON list sorted by the primary key
definition: Serialize all recovered rows into a valid JSON array of objects each with the required small fields (integer id, string name, integer value), sorted ascending by id with no duplicate ids.
failure_mode: Wrong types, duplicates, incomplete count, or misordering all fail distinct asserts.

name: expose qemu vnc and a monitoring web interface
definition: Set the vm display on vnc display one and run a web server on the standard web port for monitoring.
failure_mode: missing listeners fail the netstat assertions
